intro.p1: This Privacy Policy explains what data the “Sviy dlya Svoikh” platform (the “Platform”, “we”, “us”) collects and processes, for what purposes, how we protect it, and what rights you have.
intro.p2: This Policy applies to the website and the mobile app (if you use the Platform through the WebView/Capacitor-based app), as well as to related services and APIs.

controller.title: 1. Who is the data controller and how to contact us
controller.p1: The controller (operator) of personal data is the “Sviy dlya Svoikh” project team.

dataCollected.title: 2. What data we collect
dataCollected.intro: We process the data you provide and the technical data generated while you use the Platform:

1.label: Account data:
1.text: first and last name, e-mail, phone number (if provided), password hash (we do not store your password in plain text), account role/type.

2.label: Profile data (at your discretion):
2.text: city/region, photo/avatar, description (bio), age and gender (if filled in), family details and interests (if you fill them in), links to social networks/messengers (for example, Telegram).

3.label: Business profile data (where applicable):
3.text: information about your business/sole proprietorship (FOP), business category, contact details, links and descriptions of services.

4.label: Content and interactions:
4.text: chat messages, requests/listings, reviews/replies, ratings, favorites, complaints.

5.label: Files and images:
5.text: images you upload (for example, an avatar or photos of services/requests). We store them as files on the server and serve them via URL.

6.label: Technical and diagnostic data:
6.text: IP address, user agent, session data (token), activity time, as well as search parameters (query, city, number of results) — for security, abuse prevention and improving the service.

dataCollected.outro: The Platform is currently free of charge. We do not collect or process users’ payment data (for example, bank card details).

items.1: Directly from you — when you register, fill in your profile, publish content and send messages.
items.2: Automatically — when you use the website/app (technical data, cookies, security logs).

items.1: Creating and maintaining your account, authentication and sign-in security.
items.2: Providing Platform functionality: profiles, catalog, services, requests, chat, reviews.
items.3: Preventing fraud, abuse and spam, and ensuring security and stability.
items.4: Supporting users and responding to inquiries.

visibility.title: 5. What other users can see
visibility.p1: Some information you publish yourself, and it may be visible to other users of the Platform. For example: first/last name (or business name), city, photo, description, published services/requests, reviews. You control how most profile fields are filled in.
visibility.p2: Chat messages are visible only to the participants of the relevant conversation.

cookies.title: 6. Cookies and local storage
cookies.p1: To make authorization work, we use cookies (including httpOnly cookies) and may use the browser’s local storage (localStorage) to store technical session data. You can clear cookies and localStorage in your browser/device settings, but this may require you to sign in again.

thirdParties.title: 7. Sharing data with third parties
thirdParties.intro: We do not sell personal data. We may share data only in the following cases:

1.label: With infrastructure providers
1.text: (hosting/servers/databases) — because the service cannot operate without them.

2.label: When required by law
2.text: — if we are obliged to disclose data under applicable law and lawful requests.

thirdParties.outro: We currently do not use third-party advertising SDKs and do not show ads. If third-party analytics or advertising is added in the future, we will update this Policy.

security.title: 8. Security
security.p1: We apply reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect data: password hashing, access control, request rate limiting, security logs. At the same time, no method of data transmission or storage can be 100% secure.

retention.title: 9. Retention periods
retention.p1: We keep data for as long as necessary to operate the service and achieve the purposes of processing. For example, profile data is kept while the account is active; technical logs and sessions may be kept for a limited time for security and diagnostics.

rights.title: 10. Your rights
rights.intro: Depending on applicable law, you may have the following rights:

items.3: to delete your account and data (unless this conflicts with legal requirements);
items.4: to restrict processing in certain cases.

children.title: 11. Children
children.p1: The Platform is not intended for children under 13. If you believe a child has provided us with personal data, please contact us — we will take steps to delete such data.

changes.title: 12. Changes to this Policy
changes.p1: We may update this Policy. The current version is always available on this page. The date of the last update is shown at the top.

accountDeletion.title: Account and data deletion
accountDeletion.intro: This page describes how users of {appName} can delete their account and the data associated with it.
accountDeletion.emailSubject: Account deletion request — Sviy dlya Svoikh

now.title: Delete your account now
now.p1: If you are signed in to your profile, you can delete your account right away on this page — in the app or on the website.

steps.1: Sign in to your account on the website or in the app.
steps.2: Open this page — the account deletion form appears below.
steps.3: Enter your account password to confirm.
steps.4: Tick the box confirming that you understand the account and all related data will be deleted and cannot be restored.
steps.5: Click “Delete account permanently”. The account and related data are deleted immediately and you are signed out.

now.stepsNote: If the password is incorrect or too many attempts have been made, the form will show an error — try again later. An administrator account cannot be deleted through the form — please contact support.

request.title: 1) If you cannot sign in — submit a request

steps.1: Prepare information to identify your account: e-mail, phone number (if you provided one), and (if possible) a link to your profile or your user ID.
steps.2: Send your request in one of the following ways:
steps.3: In your message, write the phrase “Please delete my account and related data” and include your details so we can find the account (e-mail/phone).
steps.4: If necessary, we may ask for additional confirmation that the account belongs to you (to prevent deletion on someone else’s request).

deleted.title: 2) What data will be deleted
deleted.intro: After your request is confirmed, we delete or anonymize the data associated with your account, including:

items.1: account data (e-mail, password hash, account role/status);
items.2: profile data (first/last name, photo, description, contact details, social links, other profile fields);
items.3: content you published on the Platform (services/requests/reviews) — deleted or anonymized depending on the type of content;
items.4: uploaded images (avatar, photos of services/requests), unless they are needed to preserve the integrity of other records.

deleted.outro: Chat messages may be deleted or anonymized so as not to break the integrity of other users’ conversations.

retained.title: 3) What data may be retained and for how long

1.label: Technical logs
1.text: may be kept for a limited time for security and diagnostics (usually up to 90 days).

2.label: Backups
2.text: may contain some data until they are overwritten (usually up to 30 days).

3.label: Data we are required by law to retain
3.text: (where applicable) may be kept for the period required by law.

timeline.title: 4) Processing time
timeline.p1: We aim to complete a deletion request within 30 days of confirming the identity of the account owner.
